typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' Tech Variant - Extreme weight contrast between massive geometric headers and strict monospace details.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-black tracking-tighter leading-none uppercase
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono text-muted

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-32) combined with strict 1px grid borders for a technical, high-end feel.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use The 'Technical' Look: border-collapse style layout. Expose the skeleton by using 1px subtle borders (border-border) on grid items.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Max width 100vw, overflow-x-hidden. Use padding px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24 for content bounds.
spacing_and_layout.header: Fixed top-0 w-full z-50. MUST use Crystal Glass effect: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60 border-b border-white/10. NO fully transparent headers.

motion_choreography.global: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Framer Motion for scroll-linked animations.
motion_choreography.on_load_signature: Masked line-by-line reveal. Wrap each line of the hero H1 in an overflow-hidden div, and animate the inner text from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with a custom cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1) duration 1.2s.
motion_choreography.scroll_reveals: Use Framer Motion 'whileInView' with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}. Elements should subtly fade in and translate-y (y: 40 -> 0).
motion_choreography.hover_states: Images in Project section MUST have 'hover:scale-105' transition inside an 'overflow-hidden' container. Custom cursors or scale transitions on buttons are highly recommended.
motion_choreography.parallax: Use Framer Motion 'useScroll' and 'useTransform' on the 3D canvas container to make it move at a different speed than the text.

3d_libraries_and_setup.hero_3d_concept: Interactive 3D center piece. Use a `<TorusKnot>` or `<Icosahedron>` with a `<MeshPhysicalMaterial>` (metalness: 1, roughness: 0.2, clearcoat: 1) to simulate a dark chrome/liquid metal look. Add `<Environment preset='city'>` and `<Float>` from drei to make it hover.
3d_libraries_and_setup.lighting: CRITICAL: Ensure adequate lighting in the R3F canvas (ambientLight + directionalLight + Environment) so the metallic material reflects.

sections.hero: 100vh sticky container. Massive kinetic typography overlaid on top of the R3F Canvas. Text has mix-blend-difference or z-index 10 to float above the 3D model. Signature load animation here.
sections.about: Numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., '[ 01 ] THE PHILOSOPHY'). Technical grid layout, large typography, massive negative space.
sections.skills: One slow editorial marquee using 'react-fast-marquee'. Outline text (text-transparent webkit-text-stroke) moving infinitely.
sections.projects: Real product photography treated deliberately. 1-column or 2-column large grid. Spotlights/clipped frames (overflow hidden with internal hover scale).
sections.contact: Visual-only form. Strict minimalist inputs (bg-transparent, border-b only, focus:border-white). Large 'LET\'S TALK' heading.

image_urls.description: Close-up of smartphone camera lens array

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Use aria-hidden='true' on decorative 3D elements and marquees. All inputs must have explicit focus rings (focus:ring-white). Include 'prefers-reduced-motion' media queries to disable lenis/framer-motion if requested.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Commit to the dark, brutalist-tech aesthetic.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition specific properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
Ensure 'lenis' is wrapped correctly at the root of the layout to enable momentum scrolling.
Do NOT use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) anywhere. Keep the tone premium and serious.
Buttons should be sharp or slightly rounded with crisp 1px borders, avoiding pill shapes for this brutalist layout.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install these dependencies using yarn: @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis lucide-react react-fast-marquee tailwind-merge clsx
Implement the UI using .js (JSX) extensions. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Prioritize raw HTML/Tailwind over Shadcn components for this marketing-focused portfolio to ensure custom layout freedom.
Create a 'LenisProvider' component to wrap the application for momentum scroll.
Create a 'Hero3D' component for the R3F Canvas and place it behind the kinetic typography in the hero section.
Construct the Manifesto as a grid with massive negative space, numbered chapters, and 1px border separators.
Build a pure CSS/Framer Motion visual-only Contact form at the bottom with a minimal, brutalist input style.
